== Strategy ==

EDIT-------------------->>> Forget Ki-Adi-Mundi, I replaced him w/ Anakin's racer, for pdrace defense seeing as how I dont have the shield or the effect for that matter--I haven't bought that much R3

I am also toying with the Idea of Tantive 4 and Red Leader in Red 1 for some early attacks against the new Invasion objective,,please advise.

<<<<<--------------------------------End Edit

Basically its lightside senate that I base on Naboo for Amidala's retieval engine, keeping her at the senate is a opretty secure alter free, hard to kill retieval bonus, and in conjunction with Menace fades makes any drain and avoid decks (which I hate) pretty weak against this.

Start--
you should have two senators in your opening hand,,, or at least some political guys.  So throw any of those down, if your not playing against DS senate you should keep contorl of the senate pretty easliy.  the senators you want arguing your case are Vallorum, Mas Ammeda Amidala and Palpy,  everyone else use as fodder for the political effects.  Vallorum has a nice force activation bonus with Ammy.  Ammy has the really nice direct damage when you OCCUPY a battleground site and system.  Amidala with retrieval and Palpy with the beauty of a power bonus,
I start witht the council chamber because of the activation, Jedi are just an offshoot of that.  Dapa and yoda arent crucial to the deck but they help and can come in handy.

MIDDLE GAME-- Search for Naboo docking bay and COR docking bay.  Throw down any ther Naboo sites you get, and use MOTF to pull sites when you need them.  Use Ohylo and Secure route to get control early and for big drains at the courtyard and throne room. Use the Jedi and their saber and Panaka and his blaster to hold those three sites, thats all you need.  If you have spare senators use them as forfiet fodder, they are pretty hefty in that department with Security Control.

LATE GAME-- Use MOTR to retrieve late force, should be a goof 4 or 5 along woth your Naboo retrival.  ABttle when necessary and hold your own.  Space might be hard but just pick your battles and be smart.

That is pretty much it thank you for your reviews in advance.

Snoogans
Silent-James
